title: b7z9.5.2b: Node RX fragment wiring — AuthenticatedFragmentReceiver into Stack::receive + peer-context authority
description: Second child of b7z9.5.2, lands after b7z9.5.2.1 (policy field) and b7z9.5.3 decision on peer authority. Requires bringing PeerContextAuthority/AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext plumbing into the node Stack (currently absent — decompress_authenticated_frame uses the failure-tracker only): map LinkLayer pinned PeerIdentity pubkeys to AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext, derive the AuthenticatedFragmentationPermit from FragmentationPolicy admission, then wire Stack::receive: fragment-kind L2 payloads (after L2 verify) feed the receiver bounded by the policy; expire_due hook on the receive loop; completed datagrams proceed into decompress_authenticated_frame; incomplete/expiring state dropped Ok(None) per spec; ReceiverResult controls (ACKs) need the TX path from b7z9.5.3 — if TX is unavailable, document drop semantics rather than dead-ends. Loopback-pair tests: fragment from a FragmentSender over loopback radios, reassemble, decompress, deliver; incomplete -> Ok(None); policy exhaustion -> clean rejection. DO NOT START until b7z9.5.2.1 lands and the peer-authority source (rpl_stack secure vs new plumbing) is decided.
